scope: Kaby i5-8250U Qwen3/Qwen2.5 strict CPU warm-session performance lane after SLM-CPU-177
claim_boundary: SLM-CPU-178 inspects the selected dense-linear output-storage sub-boundary only.
No runtime behavior changes are made in this slice.
No allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, Q4/Q5, server, GPU/NPU/OpenVINO/UHD 620, Qwen3.5, or BitNet QK256 claim is made.

Any later runtime change must preserve paired Qwen3 Q8_0 and Qwen2.5 Q8_0 strict before/after model SHA, GGUF tokenizer authority, prompt IDs, generated IDs, decoded text, selected CPU backend/kernel identity, dense hook identity where applicable, and fallback_used=false.

code_evidence.evidence: FeedForward::apply_linear selects QK256 only when raw QK256 data exists, otherwise calls maybe_forward_dense_q8_sidecar_linear and then falls back to candle_nn::Linear::forward(input), which returns an owned Tensor.

DenseLinearOutputStorageApiBoundary records weight/bias readability but marks dense_linear_output_storage_blocked_by_candle_tensor_ops because Tensor::matmul plus optional broadcast_add return owned tensors without caller-provided output storage.
The source-order Q8 sidecar helper can fill a local output slice, but the public runtime still constructs and returns a Candle Tensor with Tensor::from_vec.
The packed Q8 sidecar helper builds an output Vec and must still construct a returned Candle Tensor with Tensor::from_vec.
Warm-session allocation audit records feed_forward.down_proj.output as the first reusable allocation surface while can_fill_caller_output_storage=false.

feasibility_classification.reason: The behavior-preserving production dense-linear path returns owned Candle Tensor outputs. Current backend-local helpers can fill temporary host slices or Vecs, but the transformer interface still requires a returned Tensor, and public Tensor construction takes owned storage rather than reusable caller-owned output storage.

compute_side_blockers.blocker: returns owned Tensor output and exposes no caller-provided output-storage parameter
returns owned Tensor output and exposes no caller-provided output-storage parameter for bias add
constructs returned Tensor by consuming owned Vec storage, so caller-owned reusable storage cannot outlive the returned Tensor boundary

backend_local_slice_feasibility.why: Current runtime consumers require Candle Tensor semantics immediately after dense linear output; helper-local output slices are consumed or copied into a returned Tensor before downstream use.

no_bias_fast_path_feasibility.why: A no-bias dense-linear path can skip broadcast_add only for biasless tensors, but matmul still returns an owned Tensor and therefore does not solve the output-storage boundary.

required_api_or_design: Candle matmul_out or equivalent API that fills caller-provided output storage while preserving Tensor semantics
Candle broadcast_add_out or equivalent API for optional bias without owned Tensor output
or a typed fused consumer that owns every downstream dense-linear consumer stage and avoids returned Tensor materialization
required_receipts: Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 strict before/after warm-session receipt pair
Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q8_0 strict before/after warm-session receipt pair
measurement_required_before_claim: allocation counters for the exact dense-linear surface
timing fields for the affected warm-session phase
unchanged strict provenance and generated behavior

feasibility_classification.selected_next_frontier_reason: SLM-CPU-178 finds no safe runtime candidate from current public APIs; the next useful slice should either define the runtime-disabled caller-output-storage gate in enough detail for implementation or record that the blocker must move upstream to Candle.

must_not_claim: SLM-CPU-178 proves allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, or sustained throughput.
Candle Tensor matmul, broadcast_add, final-norm, residual-add, output-head, or model.forward caller-output-storage blockers are resolved.
A no-bias fast path solves the output-storage boundary.
Packed-Q8 or source-order sidecar paths are promoted to default runtime.
Q4_K_M or Q4_K_S runtime support exists.
Server, GPU, NPU, OpenVINO, or UHD 620 execution is involved.
Qwen3.5 or hybrid architecture support is in scope.
